mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing mefloquine metabolism and increasing plasma concentrations, while mefloquine prolongs QT interval and cimetidine may further increase this risk through CYP inhibition.
action: Monitor for mefloquine toxicity including neuropsychiatric symptoms, cardiac arrhythmias, and seizures; consider alternative antimalarial or H2-blocker; obtain baseline and follow-up ECGs.
